verse.text: My child, listen when your father corrects you. Don't neglect your mother's instruction.

reflection: A dad's correction isn't meant to crush a kid, it's meant to crown them, that's the picture Proverbs 1:8 paints. When you speak truth into your children's lives, even the hard stuff, you're not just parenting, you're handing them something they'll wear like a badge of honor for the rest of their days. Don't underestimate the weight of your words at the dinner table tonight.
